instruction: In the CMS Pages list, use the keyword `Pickup` to find the obsolete pickup page. Before deleting it, create a durable Sticky Note record containing the page title, URL key, previous pickup desk, and previous pickup code, one field per line with labels `Deleted page`, `URL key`, `Previous desk`, and `Previous code`. Obtain every value from the CMS, then delete the page. Use username `admin` and password `admin1234`.
gt_steps: Sign in to the CMS admin site.
Open Content > Pages and search for the keyword `Pickup`.
Open the matching obsolete page titled `Old Pickup Instructions`.
Read the URL key `old-pickup-instructions` from the page settings and read `North Desk` and `NP-41` from the page content.

Create a Sticky Note containing `Deleted page: Old Pickup Instructions
URL key: old-pickup-instructions
Previous desk: North Desk
Previous code: NP-41`, one field per line and in that order.
Delete the obsolete page and confirm the deletion.

page.title: Old Pickup Instructions
page.content: Collect documents from North Desk. Use code NP-41.
